text_block_list.name: French Newsagent
text_block_list.text:
"—Extra! Read all about it!!
That very legend—is entering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!"

text_block_list.name: French Newsagent
text_block_list.text: "The legends who conquered the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe have all announced their entries at once!"

text_block_list.name: French Newsagent
text_block_list.text:
Europe's treasure, Rigantona!
And the French legend...
Montjeu has entered the race as well!!

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"...Master. Why did you keep
news like this a secret from me?"

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
""Yeah. Rumor has it that legendary icon,
Rigantona, is making a comeback.""

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "Thaaat's wroooong!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"‘...Had I known you were running,
I would have prepared countermeasures well in advance.’"

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: "Fufu... That's why I kept it a secret."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
“――Come.
Young sprouts who carry the future on your shoulders.”

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: "Let us begin the supreme race that will go down in history."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
Did you see their race entry declarations too?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: One of them alone is terrifying enough, but two legends entering the fray? There's no precedent for this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The news wasn't just a special edition in France;
media outlets all around the world reported on it simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strongest in Europe... Hearing that,
no one could fail to mention the names of those two.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are "prodigies"
who conquered the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
in the very year of their first appearance in the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe wasn't her only victory;
she has continued to conquer numerous other European G1 races.
...True legends, the both of them.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...They will likely carry the pride of their nation on their shoulders as well.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It's different from "expectations"—
it's the champion's sheer drive
that dictates they must never lose.
choice_data_list: It seems this won't be so simple.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Let's start working on a countermeasure today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that enthusiasm, I headed over
to the training grounds, but—

text_block_list.name: Foreign Journalist A
text_block_list.text:
"Rigantona!
Why enter the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe again?!
Could she be aiming to break the legendary course record once more—?!"

text_block_list.name: Foreign Journalist B
text_block_list.text: "Montjeu-san! Can your pupil Venus Park truly be a worthy rival to you?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...The atmosphere of the place had been completely taken over by the legends."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Don't let it swallow you up.
We're still in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain the training menu to <chrname>.
When I also call out to the Umamusume supporting us—

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ...Unique.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ...Can I run with you guys too?

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"No, Rigantona.
Just because you can speak Japanese doesn't mean you should just go invite them out of nowhere."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
You girls should run at your own pace.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: ...Montjeu, is that an invitation from you?

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: That's right. Now, then...

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: —Show me you can etch your name into history!
I heard the sound of the wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The earth trembles. The shock shakes right through to the brain.
Behind the dazzling run of these two—no one can keep up.

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
"Aha—... Yes. That's it, this heat...
Ah... Aaaahh! Montjeu!"

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: "Let us engage in a heart-stirring battle!!"

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: "I accept your challenge! Rigantona!!"

Their run shook the earth and made the turf dance.
Just watching it sends chills down my spine.

The turf was so heavy their feet sank deep into it,
yet neither of them showed the slightest sign of struggle.
...It was simply fast, and powerful.

"...Even now, after training is over,
the way Montjeu and the others ran
is still burned into my mind."
"On the day of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, not only will those two be running, but Venus Park will be there too."

What kind of direction should I give <chrname> moving forward?
Above all, what strategy should we use on race day—
choice_data_list: ...What must we do to defeat them?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: You've gained a fantastic perspective there!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
It seems we have continued to grow
even after coming here!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Last year, we were so desperate to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe that we didn't care about our opponent's condition, did we?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
However, she is different this year.
She is calmly analyzing her opponent
and preparing a response.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Strength is what grants one composure.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry too much.
We have the strength to compete against them as well.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mei. Regarding the future training
for the representative girls—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "We've already discussed it so that each person adjusts according to their own physical condition."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
With last year behind us,
the fruits of a year's preparation are showing.
You have the ability to compete with anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: All that's missing now is confidence.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: It's what supports them in the end.
